conclusion: Approximately 4000 most plausibly refers to the first brigade occupying Vitoria, not the entire division. This is a contextual inference resolving a grammatically ambiguous feminine relative; it is not a textual emendation.

evidence.finding: Places the first brigade with Verdier at Vitoria, the second under Ducos at Hernani. Projected forces across Biscay amount to 10000 under Verdier.

evidence.locator: Toreno, Historia del levantamiento, guerra y revolución de España, volume 1, printed pp. 125–126
evidence.finding: Contemporary participant-historian explicitly describes 4000 men occupying Vitoria under Verdier, before cavalry reinforcement from Burgos.
